derived_from: docs/frontend/audits/ui-07/account-page-matrix.json (generated from the canonical YAML) at run time by tests/e2e/support/ui16Visual.ts

run.environment: Windows 10, Chromium (Playwright 1.62.0), vite preview of the UI-16 tree

theme_checks: first paint is light under an OS dark preference on one dashboard per account (8/8)
an explicit dark choice persists across reload and in-app navigation
prefers-reduced-motion leaves no transition/animation above 50ms on the recomposed shell
manual_checks: keyboard: skip link first, Tab through header disclosures and sidebar, gated entry reachable and announces its gate (agent-driven browser checks via the existing role-navigation-keyboard and phase-23 specs; no screen-reader software was available — not claimed)
200% zoom: exercised as a 640x400 CSS viewport, not by OS-level browser zoom
compiled_utilities: every static template utility compiles to a rule in the built stylesheet (negative control proves an unconfigured colour and the sm: screen are reported)
